gloss: mid-level; mid-career; core member; center fielder

definitions.explanation: A person or group that forms the main body of an organization, between newcomers and senior management.
In baseball, the player who covers center field.

examples.japanese: {中堅|ちゅうけん}{社員|しゃいん}として{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: I'm active as a mid-level employee.

examples.japanese: {中堅|ちゅうけん}{企業|きぎょう}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work at a mid-sized company.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はチームの{中堅|ちゅうけん}として{重要|じゅうよう}な{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす。
examples.english: He plays an important role as a core member of the team.

notes:
FORMATION:
{中|ちゅう} (middle) + {堅|けん} (firm, solid)

USAGE:
・{中堅|ちゅうけん}{社員|しゃいん} (mid-career employee)
・{中堅|ちゅうけん}{企業|きぎょう} (mid-sized company)
・{中堅|ちゅうけん}{どころ} (the backbone, core group)
・{中堅|ちゅうけん}{層|そう} (middle tier)

NUANCE:
Implies reliability and experience. Often refers to employees with 5-15 years of experience who are neither new nor in senior management.

BASEBALL:
{中堅|ちゅうけん}{手|しゅ} - center fielder (formal)
センター - center fielder (common)
